purpose: Raw upstream Flow to owned backend input audit; structural mapping and compile acceptance are separate from runtime verification.

reviewed_contracts.result: Exhaustive Rust matches cover all variants in the pinned upstream Builtin, Type, Term, Stmt, Value, FiberOp, RuntimeOp and supporting enums. Function/local/sequence/label/enum/effect IDs preserve arena order. TypeMap translates producer IDs explicitly instead of assuming shared builtin numbering. Rust exhaustiveness establishes structural handling only; runtime evidence is separate.
Only Stage::Flow is accepted; upstream verifier runs before conversion. Function env/defects metadata from later stages is rejected. Backend lowers closures, handlers and suspension exactly once.

Configured names must resolve uniquely to upstream public roots. Duplicate names/aliases and private helpers are rejected. Unselected public roots are not exposed to C. Frontend retains official annotation and target validation.

Copies only type, enum and effect declarations. Core function bodies are neither examined nor rewritten. Error display function mapping is preserved from Flow. Standard generated Eq/Show implementations remain ordinary Flow bodies.

Positions, active statements, expanding enum analysis and has_scopes start empty/false and are recomputed by backend passes. They are not inherited from the old frontend or inferred from generated names.

Keeps each received const function as a distinct upstream identity. No const family tracing, canonical initializer reconstruction or extra monomorphization. UPSTREAM-001 remains a known upstream behavioral exception, not a completed sharing test.

Official pinned upstream has no Bytes primitive. Emelino.Bytes is supplied as an ordinary external module. The adapter verifies opaque type shape, exact function identities, channels and all eight signatures before connecting existing backend byte intrinsics. Input source receives no core privilege; pure methods and byte runtime are reused.

The documented box_result wrapper encodes a no-representation callback result as an empty String reference. An exact typed closure/call/return shape is translated to an owned Unit box. Ordinary empty Strings are unchanged; callback invocation and its effect/failure channels remain.
Reuses the old backend landing policy on owned Program: an infallible raise gets a local failure landing and the existing checked runtime helper. No upstream module or Core body mutation.

Term::Defect preserves its message operand. The optional assertion location field is absent from the inherited backend contract, matching the fixed old embedded adapter; precise assertion-location preservation is not newly claimed.

scope_findings.observation: The previous independent frontend added generic error declarations such as error Payload[A](value:A). Neither fixed c34 oldfork nor current official frontend parses this declaration. These source tests are not evidence required for fixed oldfork source parity; generic-error owned IR tests remain a separate backend contract.

evidence.fact: error_decl parses name, optional fields and derive, without type_param_list.
error_decl has no optional type_params, unlike type_decl and enum_decl.

official_observation.diagnostic: E0122: expected newline after declaration at [ after Payload

scope_findings.raw_flow_policy: AsError uses its declared destination type. IsError on a generic error enum without concrete type metadata is diagnosed, not guessed from names or unrelated statements.

scope_findings.observation: The multi-file Embedded.Local corpus program retains app/src paths from the original driver test. In the explicit source API, paths are supplied relative to that source root. Both original source bodies are retained; no module or source semantic implementation is added.

Eleven original corpus programs import the fork-only Std.Bytes module. Their compile acceptance test changes only import Std.Bytes to import Emelino.Bytes, then uses official frontend APIs and the explicit extension ABI.

The unchanged escaped_result function has unresolved State[Int] evidence. The corpus first asserts the adapter diagnostic, then wraps its two reader calls in State.run(0, fn(){...}). Runtime evidence keeps the original captured-state result83. This is1 concrete public-entry adaptation, not acceptance of the unchanged original.

validation.meaning: The source corpus test verifies frontend acceptance, Flow adaptation and C artifact generation under explicit ample capacities. It does not execute C or replace old runtime assertions. Runtime verification uses separate reused source/C harnesses and their original capacities.
